## Review and Adopt Agenda

Agenda shared on screen shows 3 p.m. start time instead of correct 2 p.m. start time. Posted agenda is accurate.

## Motion :

E. Huntley motions to adopt agenda with 2 p.m. ET start time. J. Alley seconds motion.

Agenda is adopted.

## Review and Adopt Minutes Motion :

J. Alley motions to approve the minutes from 1/19/25. E. Huntley seconds motion.

Minutes are approved.

## Budgetary Expense Categories

Staff will send out budget to committee before next meeting.

- E. Huntley suggests increasing travel budgeted expenses. L. Marx recommends separating out into categories for meetings such as room, PA/audio, hotel, transportation.
- C. Sims this budget was created with the plan to co-meet with FSMB. Going forward in person meetings would be more expensive but there is the option to meet virtually.
- o J. Alley points out that not all members are associated with FSMB and should be given equal opportunity.
- o K. Scarbalis agrees and notes that as the commission grows this may occur more often.
- N. Kalfas - some commissions make travel policies that finance recommends to rule to create a rule around. For example, provide travel if there are funds.
- o N. Kalfas will gather some information about travel policies.

## Insurance Update

N. Kalfas gives an update

- The application is complete. N. Kalfas will meet with representatives and explain compacts. The estimate cost is significantly less than the draft budgeted amount at this time.
- Once cybersecurity insurance is included, this will likely grow.

## MOU

NCCPA and AAPA have approved $150,000 each.

- G. Thomas - The NCCPA board has approved funding and sees this as an investment for the future.

The MOU has 4 signatories (CSG, NCCPA, AAPA and commission)

- CSG will hold the funds
